status: Original OpenRC design (step 16): a fast swept flying wing (delta-planform pusher) in the 0.78 m speed-wing class (Multiplex FunJet Ultra 2 class). Our own parametric outline from the class's published headline figures (span, wing area, flying weight, drive); no kit drawing, CAD, photograph or livery was used.
class_reference: Multiplex FunJet ULTRA 2 listings (checked 2026-11-17): span 783 mm, flying weight 875 g, 4S LiPo, ROXXY C35-36 1960 Kv outrunner, 6x5.5 propeller, two HS-65HB servos, about 220 km/h (shop.multiplex-rc.de item 1-01030, lindinger.at); wing area 14.5 dm2 and length 750 mm (skyraccoon.com). Used as class figures only.
frame: LE frame [x_aft, y_right, z_up] in metres; D0 = wing root leading edge on the symmetry plane at the wing chord plane

wing.reflex_note: reflexed speed section; the section moment and washout are estimates in FD-01 inputs

fuselage.stations_note: [x, half width, bottom z, top z]; a slim centre body with the wing on its chord plane; the motor sits in its tail
